## Themes

# Code

## Showing code

Code is not echoed by default.

```{r}
#| echo: true
ggplot2::qplot(x = Sepal.Length, data = iris)
```

## Highlighting lines

Line numbers are shown if it is echoed.

```{r}
#| echo: fenced
#| code-line-numbers: "3,5-6"
iris |>
  ggplot() +
  geom_point(
    mapping = aes(
      x = Sepal.Length,
      y = Sepal.Width
    )
  )
```
